achievement.title: Voice input overview
achievement.subtitle: Your cumulative achievements
achievement.methodIntro: A clear basis for every achievement.
achievement.methodCounts: Characters count non-whitespace characters in saved text, including punctuation. Sessions count saved entries. Recording time excludes recognition, refinement and editing. Active days have at least one entry.
achievement.methodPeriod: Trends use local calendar days, compared with the immediately preceding period of equal length. Today is incomplete when included. Daily averages include zero-activity days. No growth percentage is shown when the previous total is zero. All history spans the earliest entry through today, automatically grouping the chart by day, week, month or year without a previous-period comparison. Daily details remain unaggregated, with 50 days per page.
achievement.methodRetention: History and statistics stay on this device until you delete them. Totals and milestones reflect retained entries and decrease when entries are deleted. Data already removed by earlier versions cannot be recovered.
achievement.retention: History stays on this device indefinitely · Delete it anytime in History
achievement.empty: Start with your first sentence. Focus a text field and hold your shortcut to speak.
achievement.loadFailed: Statistics could not be refreshed. Please try again.

linuxIntegration.title: Linux & Omarchy Integration
linuxIntegration.description: Connect Voice Key to Hyprland for reliable push-to-talk and multilingual text injection on Wayland.

settings.translateOutputHelp: After dictation, clean up the transcript and translate it into the target language. Refinement can stay off.
settings.refineEndpointHelp: Only the Base URL is needed. Do not include /chat/completions; the app adds that path automatically.
settings.refineModelHelp: This mainly edits, polishes, and structures speech transcripts. Mini or lite tiers are typically faster and cheaper, and are recommended.
settings.tokenDanceConnectHelp: Authorize in the browser to create and save a TokenDance API Key automatically, or paste an existing key below.

settings.durationWarning: Record for up to 5 minutes. Classic mode processes the complete recording after release; longer recordings require more time and memory.
settings.lowVolumeModeHelp: Enable for quiet speech. Gain includes peak protection but also amplifies background noise. Off by default.
